at_most_initial_custody_conclusion: two exact remote share copies independently read back on specified hosts
forbidden_actions: no share retrieval or remote job by this review
no removal of pending source shares or nonce
no root token or share1 transfer

identity_rules.mode: accept actual native int; explicit string only parsed as octal; never stringify private pins into a public record
identity_rules.native_version: parse original dev:inode:bytes:mtime_ns:ctime_ns using Python exact ints

independent_review_input: only original metadata receipts and private pin envelopes; share bytes are not re-read by the reviewer
not_proven_by_transfer: actual threshold unseal or third-share recovery
exclusive 3-host custody while Mac pending copies remain
encrypted private storage or complete device-loss recovery
safe retirement of source pending copies or init nonce/capsule

allowed: safe path/owner/mode and complete native observation booleans
source/current/destination whole-byte and identity equality booleans
complete ACL/xattr observation and expected-policy booleans
separate payload transfer count and completed readback count
forbidden: any secret-derived SHA, argv-derived share fingerprint or private closure content SHA
filled binary read/write request or raw response containing encoded share
root token or recovery nonce values
unqualified claims of exclusive share separation or disk-loss recovery

required_per_transfer_evidence: current receiver root and unseal-share directory full identity match their original successful preparation; target is currently absent
source role path is from actual initialized private closure, no caller-selected alternate
original source native file_info before read equals actual init private pin; real regular file uid501 gid20 mode0600 nlink1
binary_read is version-bound offset0 through exact whole file EOF with full length; decode payload only inside function memory
independently hash full source payload in memory and compare to both private init pin and native source full SHA
source native file_info after read retains exact version identity bytes and SHA
destination binary_write is create-only expected_version absent with exact intended0600 and full SHA; no overwrite or retries after unknown mutation
destination native file_info version/size/full SHA equals successful write receipt and exact source bytes; uid1000 gid1000 mode0600 nlink1 regular nonsymlink
destination ACL and xattr observation is complete; no extra ACL or xattrs beyond the explicitly accepted empty baseline
destination binary_read binds the committed original version, reads whole EOF, and independently matches every payload byte/fullSHA in function memory
destination native file_info after readback remains exact same original version/fullidentity/bytes/SHA
receiver root and share directory identity after transfer remains original dev/inode/uid/gid/mode
temporary payload references are discarded after each single-share transfer; no combined plaintext multi-share file, request dump or archive is persisted

requires_actual_init_success.private_closure: full independent native version/identity/bytes/SHA pinned to actual initialized public closure identity
requires_actual_init_success.result_and_final_stdout: initialized_sealed_held,3shares,threshold2,matching source/data generation and complete original FD/short-process cleanup
requires_actual_init_success.terminal: succeeded exit0 non-timeout non-cancel complete durable confirmed

unknown_mutation_rule: hold original operation; reconcile same target/version/readback through read-only native observations; never rewrite or replace a target to produce success
